name: Account & credentials panel (WP-02 phase 3)
description: Before this panel there was NO bridge logout in the app at all — /api/logout existed but nothing called it. Asserts the panel exists, that its labels resolve from strings.yaml, that destructive actions use the two-click arm (window.confirm silently no-ops in the iPad PWA), and that revoking the script token really invalidates it server-side while leaving this browser logged in. Reaching the app at all also proves ?tkn= now takes the derived api_token.

steps.comment: GATE 1: ?tkn={{TKN}} authenticated us — the api_token works where the password used to
steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/welcome/projects'); return { status: r.status, PASS: r.status === 200 }; })()

steps.comment: Open Settings on the System tab
steps.script: (async () => { window.WidgetManager.open('config', { tab: 'system' }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); return !!document.querySelector('#account-section'); })()

steps.comment: GATE 2: the Account section exists with all three controls
steps.script: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#account-section'); const title = s?.querySelector('.system-section-title')?.textContent.trim(); const ids = ['account-logout','account-revoke-browsers','account-revoke-scripts']; const found = ids.filter(i => !!s?.querySelector('#'+i)); return { title, found, PASS: title === 'Account & Credentials' && found.length === 3 }; })()

steps.comment: GATE 3: every label/description resolved from strings.yaml — no blanks, no literal 'undefined'. (A bare `on:`/`off:` YAML key would silently become a boolean and render empty here.)
steps.script: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#account-section'); const texts = [...s.querySelectorAll('.system-setting-name, .system-setting-desc, .system-btn, .config-hint')].map(e => e.textContent.trim()); const bad = texts.filter(t => !t || /undefined|\[object/i.test(t)); return { count: texts.length, bad, PASS: texts.length === 10 && bad.length === 0 }; })()

steps.comment: GATE 4: local logout is NOT armed — it's cheap and reversible, arming it would imply a blast radius it doesn't have
GATE 5a: first click only ARMS a destructive button — label swaps, nothing fires
steps.script: (async () => { const b = document.querySelector('#account-revoke-browsers'); const before = b.textContent.trim(); b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const after = b.textContent.trim(); return { before, after, armed: b.classList.contains('armed'), stillHere: location.pathname === '/app', PASS: b.classList.contains('armed') && after !== before && location.pathname === '/app' }; })()

steps.comment: GATE 5b: blurring disarms, so a stray tap can't leave a live trigger sitting on screen. (Needs an explicit focus() first: a programmatic .click() doesn't focus the element, so blur() would be a no-op and this would pass vacuously.)
steps.script: (async () => { const b = document.querySelector('#account-revoke-browsers'); b.focus(); b.blur(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return { armed: b.classList.contains('armed'), label: b.textContent.trim(), PASS: !b.classList.contains('armed') && b.textContent.trim() === 'Log out everywhere' }; })()

steps.comment: GATE 6: the current api_token authenticates on its own. Probes a NON-/api/ authenticated path with credentials omitted, because (a) same-origin XHR sends cookies regardless of withCredentials and the cookie is checked first server-side, masking a dead token, and (b) a fetch to /api/* that 401s trips auth-fetch.js's global redirect to /login and destroys the execution context.
steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/static/js/app.js?probe=' + 1, { credentials: 'omit', cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer {{TKN}}' } }); return { status: r.status, PASS: r.status === 200 }; })()

steps.comment: Revoke the script token: two clicks (arm, then commit)
steps.script: (async () => { const b = document.querySelector('#account-revoke-scripts'); b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return 'clicked'; })()

steps.comment: GATE 7: the old api_token is dead server-side, immediately, with no restart. Same probe shape as gate 6.
steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/static/js/app.js?probe=' + 2, { credentials: 'omit', cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer {{TKN}}' } }); return { status: r.status, PASS: r.status === 401 }; })()

steps.comment: GATE 8: ...and this browser is still logged in. Revoking scripts must not touch cookies — that separation is the entire point of two epochs.
steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/welcome/projects'); const onApp = location.pathname === '/app'; return { status: r.status, onApp, PASS: r.status === 200 && onApp }; })()
